sentences.en: Rapidity of rise may be inversely proportional to duration at altitude.
sentences.zh: 上升的速度可能与高空中的持续时间成反比。

sentences.en: The duration of the tennis match was five hours.
sentences.zh: 网球比赛持续了五个小时。

sentences.en: The duration of passion is proportionate with the original resistance of the woman.
sentences.zh: 激情的持续时间与女性最初的抵抗力成正比。

mnemonic: 词根记忆：dur（持久）+ation→持久时间
